svg.title: Kidney
svg.desc: An idealised adult kidney has a convex lateral border, a concave medial hilum, a smooth capsular surface, renal artery, renal vein and ureter.
svg.text: External surface and structures at the hilum

text.tspan: External illustrative view. Hilar structures have been separated for clarity. No sided anatomical variation is implied; not to scale.
Anatomical reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 25.3.
